stories.summary: India has become the largest market for battery-powered auto rickshaws, with one rolling off the production line every 90 seconds. stories.title: Structural batteries proposed to reduce EV weight
stories.summary: Automakers are exploring structural batteries to address the weight disadvantage of electric vehicles compared to gas-powered models. By integrating the battery pack into the vehicle structure, designers aim to make cars lighter and stronger. The design presents new challenges regarding the repairability of the battery pack.

stories.title: Battery electric vehicles close gap on petrol cars in UK
stories.summary: Battery electric vehicles reached 32 percent of new car registrations in the UK in October, according to the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders. Petrol cars held a 5.2 percentage point lead, the smallest gap recorded to date. Total market registrations rose 5.4 percent year-on-year.

stories.title: Hybrid cars gain ground as EV momentum slows
stories.summary: Hybrids are becoming a hot commodity in the U.S. market, outpacing electric vehicles that once dominated industry projections. While automakers invested billions in a transition to electric, hybrid sales are reaching record shares as EV momentum struggles to maintain its earlier pace.

stories.title: EV price gap narrows against combustion cars
stories.summary: The average new electric vehicle now costs 9.4 percent more than a gas car, according to Kelley Blue Book. This represents a significant decline from the 16 percent price gap observed last year. Incentives are playing a shrinking role in the narrowing cost difference.

stories.title: Electric vehicles displace millions of oil barrels
stories.summary: Electric vehicles and plug-in hybrids displaced 2.3 million barrels of oil consumption per day in 2025, according to BloombergNEF. The company projects this figure will more than double by the end of the decade as global sales of battery-powered vehicles continue to climb.

stories.title: MG electric vehicle registrations triple in India
stories.summary: MG recorded 1,545 registrations for its Hector Tomahawk EV in October, up from 443 in September. Electric models accounted for 84 percent of all MG passenger vehicle registrations during the month. The company now relies heavily on its battery-powered lineup.

stories.title: Report surveys damage to U.S. electric vehicle transition
stories.summary: A new BloombergNEF report estimates that only 17 percent of U.S. car sales will have a plug by 2030. This projection falls far below previous industry expectations. The report suggests that policy shifts have significantly derailed the expected transition to electric vehicles.

stories.summary: Kia expects its 30,000 dollar EV3 to become its best-selling electric vehicle in the U.S. The launch follows the struggles of the Chevy Bolt and Nissan Leaf, which failed to gain widespread traction despite offering lower prices and fewer compromises than previous electric models.

stories.title: Australian electric vehicle sales triple
stories.summary: Battery electric vehicles accounted for 23.1 percent of new cars sold in Australia during October, nearly triple the share from the same period last year. NRMA noted that the numbers are stark, as rising petrol prices continue to influence consumer purchasing decisions.

stories.title: Project JOLT trials encourage electric truck adoption
stories.summary: Project JOLT, led by the Centre for Sustainable Road Freight, found that operators could save 0.21 pounds per kilometer in fuel costs by switching to electric trucks. The trials helped hauliers identify suitable routes for battery-electric vehicles, prompting three UK firms to invest in the technology.

stories.title: India moves to standardize hydrogen truck engines
stories.summary: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy is working with the Automotive Research Association of India to standardize hydrogen-internal combustion engines. The initiative aims to develop alternatives to diesel for heavy-duty freight and reduce vehicular pollution, particularly in cities experiencing severe winter air quality issues.

stories.title: India launches first hydrogen-powered train
stories.summary: Indian Railways inaugurated its first indigenous hydrogen fuel cell-powered train on 17 July 2026. The locomotive generates its own electricity onboard and is scheduled to operate on the Jind-Sonipat section of the Northern Railway. The project integrates advanced propulsion with dedicated hydrogen storage and refueling infrastructure.

stories.title: IFC provides 150 million dollar loan to SBI for rural women
stories.summary: The International Finance Corporation extended a 150 million dollar social loan to State Bank of India to expand agricultural finance. The initiative aims to support 864,000 rural women across India, with 90 percent of the financing directed toward those borrowing through self-help groups.

stories.title: LG Electronics earns top automotive safety rating
stories.summary: LG Electronics has secured the ASIL D certification for its vehicle communication control module, the highest grade under the ISO 26262 standard. The component is currently fitted in the Genesis GV90. The company intends to use the certification to expand its global customer base.

stories.title: Tyre makers seek duty relief as rubber prices rise
stories.summary: Natural rubber prices are nearing 300 rupees per kilogram, prompting the Automotive Tyre Manufacturers' Association to request duty-free imports. The industry claims domestic production is falling short of demand, even as a significant area of existing rubber plantations remains untapped.

stories.title: OP Mobility commits 3,180 crore rupees to India expansion
stories.summary: OP Mobility plans to build five new plants in India over the next five years. The company currently operates six facilities in the country and expects India to be its fastest-growing global market. The investment is valued at approximately 300 million euros.

stories.title: AI used to predict supply chain shortages in Mexico
stories.summary: Mexico’s automotive industry is deploying AI to identify potential disruptions among Tier 2 suppliers. In a supply chain reliant on lean inventories, the absence of a single component can trigger production line shutdowns. Manufacturers are attempting to address these vulnerabilities before they affect vehicle assembly.

stories.title: Michelin launches fuel-efficient tyre for Indian market
stories.summary: Michelin has launched the X Multi Energy Z2, a truck and bus tyre designed for Indian operating conditions. stories.summary: Cadillac sales fell 30 percent in the third quarter, dragging down General Motors' luxury brand performance. stories.summary: India's used-car market is expected to grow from 6 million vehicles in fiscal year 2026 to 10 million by 2031. Industry estimates place the market value at 35 billion dollars today. Nearly 80 percent of transactions currently run through the informal, unorganized sector.

stories.title: SoC market expects expansion through 2035
stories.summary: The global System On Chip market is entering a phase of expansion through 2035, according to an IndexBox report. The study cites architectural migration and the redistribution of compute across automotive and industrial platforms as primary drivers, rather than simple unit volume growth. The market remains focused on procurement.

stories.title: Magnetic phone case market sees automotive growth
stories.summary: The global magnetic phone case market is shifting from a niche category to a platform-centric ecosystem, according to an IndexBox report. The proliferation of magnetic mounting systems in automotive and home environments has turned cases into modular tools. Demand is now bifurcating into a more disciplined procurement model.

stories.title: Projection welders market eyes automation
stories.summary: The global projection welders market is entering a phase of technology-driven expansion through 2035, according to an IndexBox report. Manufacturers in the automotive and appliance sectors are seeking higher throughput and improved joint quality. The process remains indispensable for concentrating force at specific points on a workpiece.

stories.title: Machine learning used to extend EV battery life
stories.summary: A new modeling framework uses machine learning to forecast battery capacity and manage retirement timing. By moving away from arbitrary capacity cutoffs, the approach aims to extend operational lifetimes and lower carbon intensity. Batteries are now being asked to work until the math says they should stop.

stories.title: Reinforcement learning tested for wire harness assembly
stories.summary: Researchers have evaluated a reinforcement learning approach for automated wire harness handling in a simulation study. The method outperformed traditional algorithmic path planning for the labor-intensive form-and-tape process. The study suggests a potential shift from single-wire routing toward module-based assembly in automotive production lines.

stories.title: Automakers shift to software-defined vehicles
stories.summary: Automakers are increasingly adopting software-defined vehicle architectures to manage complex electronic control units and connectivity. Research covering 80 manufacturers found that 45 percent are moving away from function-specific hardware. The shift aims to simplify the integration of safety features and automated driving systems as component interactions continue to multiply.

stories.title: India faces data hurdles for ADAS adoption
stories.summary: Advanced driver assistance systems in India require training on country-specific driving data to be competitive, according to Thyssenkrupp Automotive Technology executives. While ADAS is often marketed as a vehicle-level innovation, its performance remains dependent on the complex interaction between motorists and local road conditions. Data is the bottleneck.

stories.title: BlackBerry and Valeo launch AI camera platform
stories.summary: BlackBerry and Valeo have unveiled a production-ready front-view smart camera platform for Chinese automakers. The system pairs QNX software with Valeo hardware and ADAS stacks. Valeo has already secured design wins in China, and commercial production is expected to begin soon. BlackBerry shares rose 5 percent.

stories.title: Turing Drive focuses on autonomous shuttles
stories.summary: Turing Drive is developing software and hardware for low-speed autonomous electric vehicles on fixed routes. The company has logged 30,000 kilometers across 10 deployment sites. Unlike larger OEMs, the firm scales its open-source autonomy stack primarily through strategic partnerships with vehicle manufacturers for golf-style carts and shuttles.

stories.title: Study finds gains in autonomous object detection
stories.summary: Engineering researchers have developed an architecture that integrates structured knowledge distillation with multi-domain attention mechanisms to improve three-dimensional object detection. The study reported a 4.41 percentage point gain in mean average precision on benchmark driving sequences. The method aims to increase the operational stability of automated driving systems.

stories.title: Pakistan announces new five-year auto policy
stories.summary: Pakistan has unveiled an auto policy targeting 6 billion dollars in exports by 2031. The plan includes tax concessions for electric vehicles and higher financing limits to encourage domestic ownership. The government aims to transform the local industry into an export-oriented sector through new safety and manufacturing rules.

stories.title: Pakistan approves final draft of auto policy
stories.summary: The Prime Minister of Pakistan has approved the final draft of the Automotive Industry Policy. The policy aims to address structural challenges and establish a competitive, locally integrated industry. The draft will now move to the federal cabinet for formal approval through the prescribed government process.

stories.title: Pakistan announces new auto policy
stories.summary: Pakistan has announced a new auto policy focused on affordable and electric vehicles. The policy's key features were outlined by Adviser to the Prime Minister on Industries and Production Haroon Akhtar Khan at a news conference alongside Information Minister Attaullah Tarar.

stories.title: Government plans pay-per-mile tax for electric cars
stories.summary: The government plans to digitally track electric car owners for a new pay-per-mile tax. The levy, set to cost the average driver around 300 pounds a year, requires owners to provide mileage estimates to the DVLA. Petrol and diesel drivers currently contribute through fuel duty.

stories.title: Carraro India reports profit growth
stories.summary: Carraro India Limited reported an 11 percent year-on-year increase in consolidated profit after tax to 35.1 crore rupees for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Total income rose 19 percent to 705.8 crore rupees, though EBITDA margins declined to 9.2 percent from 10 percent.

stories.summary: Mexico has approved amendments to the Income Tax Law to exempt qualifying automotive manufacturing operations and commercial gasoline stations from proposed tax deduction caps. The measure, part of the 2027 Economic Package, aims to safeguard the industrial backbone of the North American automotive supply chain.

stories.title: Chevrolet wins NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series championship
stories.summary: Chevrolet celebrated a championship sweep at Homestead-Miami Speedway, marking a decade of manufacturer dominance. Justin Allgaier, driving the No. 7 JR Motorsports Chevrolet, secured his second career NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series driver championship after a season that included six victories.

stories.title: Toyota reaches 700th NASCAR victory
stories.summary: Toyota celebrated its 700th NASCAR national series win after Brandon Jones won the championship race at Homestead-Miami Speedway. Since debuting in 2004, the manufacturer has amassed 221 wins in the Cup Series, 222 in the O'Reilly Auto Parts Series, and 257 in the Truck Series.

stories.summary: The No. 7 JR Motorsports team wins their second title with Allgaier, proving he's is much more than a veteran,he is the definitive face of the series HOMESTEAD, Fla. , There is something deeply satisfying about a racer finding his exact, perfect home in motorsports.

stories.title: Allgaier secures second O'Reilly Series title
stories.summary: Justin Allgaier claimed his second NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series championship in three years after a seventh-place finish at Homestead-Miami Speedway. Brandon Jones won the season finale, delivering Toyota its 700th NASCAR victory. Allgaier is now the first driver to secure two titles in the series.

stories.title: Jesse Love finishes second in season points
stories.summary: Jesse Love finished second in the season-long points standings for Richard Childress Racing. The result follows a season-long battle for the championship title. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Filatex India invests in recycling subsidiary
stories.summary: Filatex India acquired 1.3 million equity shares of its subsidiary Ecosis for 13 million rupees. The funds are allocated to a polyester recycling project and debt repayment. The company has now invested approximately 111 million rupees into the unit.

stories.title: GWM New Zealand records best month ever
stories.summary: GWM New Zealand registered 667 vehicles in October 2026, marking its best monthly performance to date. The ORA 5 was the country's best-selling electric vehicle, while the Haval H6 accounted for nearly half of the brand's total registrations for the month.

stories.title: Volvo launches electric EX90 and ES90 in Vietnam
stories.summary: Volvo has introduced the EX90 SUV and ES90 sedan in Vietnam, priced at 3.5 billion and 2.6 billion VND respectively. Both models utilize an 800V architecture and dual-motor powertrains. The company claims the vehicles can charge from 10 to 80 percent in approximately 22 minutes.

stories.title: German automakers face profit challenges
stories.summary: BMW, Volkswagen, and Mercedes-Benz are grappling with a slump in the Chinese market and rising costs. The shift toward electric vehicles has so far failed to boost profit margins for the German manufacturers.

stories.title: BMW offers charging credit for 2027 models
stories.summary: BMW is offering 500 dollars in free charging credits for buyers of its 2027 i5, i7, and iX3 models. The offer applies to specific electric vehicles in the manufacturer's upcoming lineup.

stories.title: Cadillac reports 100,000 electric vehicle sales
stories.summary: Cadillac has sold 100,000 electric vehicles since the launch of the Lyriq in 2023. Roughly 75 percent of these buyers were new to the brand, with many transitioning from Tesla, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and Lexus.

stories.title: Tesla to end Cybertruck production in 2027
stories.summary: Elon Musk announced that Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at its Texas factory around mid-2027. The move is intended to prioritize the Cybercab robotaxi project. Musk described the Cybertruck as the best vehicle Tesla has ever made.

stories.title: Tesla to scale back Cybertruck production
stories.summary: Tesla plans to reduce Cybertruck production in 2027 to accommodate increased manufacturing of the Cybercab robotaxi. The shift at the company's Texas factory follows years of production for the futuristic pickup model.

stories.title: Porsche 911 dominates European sports car market
stories.summary: The Porsche 911 accounted for 58 percent of all sports car sales in Europe during the first half of 2026. Despite a shrinking overall market for the segment, the model maintains a significant lead supported by a loyal base of enthusiasts.

stories.title: BYD luxury brand sets production car speed record
stories.summary: The Yangwang U9 Xtreme reached 503.17 kmph in Abu Dhabi on 1 November 2026. The run was recognized by the FIA and secured two Guinness World Records for the highest speed achieved by a production car and an electric production car.

stories.title: Tesla to reduce Cybertruck output for robotaxi focus
stories.summary: Tesla will scale back Cybertruck production in mid-2027 to focus on the Cybercab project. The decision follows a 48 percent plunge in sales for the pickup. The company has not clarified future plans for the model as it pivots toward autonomous technologies.

stories.summary: The full review of the new Range Rover Electric is available for subscribers to The Times. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: GM plans second-generation Equinox EV
stories.summary: General Motors is reportedly developing a second-generation Chevrolet Equinox EV for late 2028 or early 2029. The new model is expected to shift from the current BEV3 architecture to the lower-cost BEV-N platform, despite a recent decline in sales for the current version.
